name: Jackals
background:
Jackals are species of aliens who resemble humanoid canids, and use technology built from salvaged scrap. Without access to advanced weapons or vehicles, they rely on ambush and ferocity in close combat to win. 

In the beginning, they were a collection of nomadic tribes until they discovered the wreckage of alien ships on their planet. Soon after, they made contact with the other species of Sirius, and were suddenly thrust from tribal hunters into the space age. Now the Jackals’ way of life has been forever changed, as they have begun to migrate to the stars.
backgroundFull:
The Jackals’ home world was long left uncharted due to the unique properties of their home system’s sun. Radiation from their sun reflected from the atmosphere interfered with the electronic scanners of vessels passing nearby. At a distance, it caused the scanners to detect large stores of rare elements which are used to stabilize wormholes, but ships approaching closer have their scanners and electronic systems short out completely. This has resulted in a graveyard of ships floating above the Jackals’ home world, which occasionally fall out of orbit onto the planet’s surface.

The Jackals were, until recently, made up of tribes of hunter-gatherers who migrated from oasis to oasis after their prey. This changed when the Jackals began to discover wrecked ships on their home world. The first ships were from the Robot Legion, whose pilots had been deactivated along with their ships. These wrecks gradually became a network of trading posts and cities for the wandering Jackals, and the weapons and technology contained within were salvaged and traded. The Jackals began to chase falling ships, hoping to get to the salvage first.

Eventually, the Jackals began to meet and save survivors. These survivors were taken in with the tribes, and taught the Jackals about the wider galaxy. Eventually, jump gates were established on the planet, allowing safe travel to and from their world. Jackals began working with outsiders, who valued their survival skills, tenacity and inventiveness for use as scouts and mercenaries. Many Jackals view travelling off world as a continuation of their traditional nomadic life-style.

While some might view the Jackals as backward for their traditions, these traditions have proven adaptable and continue to unite them even as they spread through the sector. The Jackals have proven their ability to quickly adapt both new ideas and technologies into their way of life, but only time will tell whether their culture will survive the shock of galactic life. 

How will you find your way among the stars?

product.description: Outcast from his own tribe for stealing, Tayra offered Ranjo a second chance with her tribe. In return, the thief has given the Shaman his loyalty and his scrapsword. Perhaps even more useful than his combat ability is his charm; he understands his fellow misfits and has always had a talent for getting others to see things his way. This has allowed him to rally a band of fellow outcasts around Tayra, willing to take a chance on the rather eccentric Shaman.

Sarcastic, cunning, and fiercely independent, Ruyi Nonga has spent her life scavenging the wreckage of a broken galaxy. She trusts no one—loss has taught her that much. Armed with explosives and cutting-edge tech, she’s as dangerous as she is resourceful. But when betrayal forces her to reconsider everything she knows, Ruyi faces a choice: continue running or stand and fight. As the weight of her past clashes with the hope of something more, she must navigate the fine line between self-preservation and loyalty, proving that even the most hardened survivor can find a cause worth fighting for.

product.description: After a tragic accident, Tayra was narrowly saved through fusing salvaged Robot Legion technology to her skull. Since then, she has claimed to hear whispers from the ship that her people have been gradually salvaging for the last five years. Most of Tayra’s tribe have written off her tales of the crashed vessel speaking to her as lubricating fluids seeping into her head; but a handful of outcasts and misfits have rallied around her, hoping that she may have been touched by the spirits that can lead them to fame and fortune.

specialRules.name: Ranged Shrouding Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Ranged Shrouding.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Shielded
specialRules.description: Units where most models have this rule get +1 to Defense rolls against hits that are not from spells.

specialRules.name: Crossing Attack
specialRules.description: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

specialRules.name: Stealth Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Stealth.

specialRules.name: Scrapper
specialRules.description: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.

specialRules.name: Precise
specialRules.description: Gets +1 to hit when attacking.

specialRules.name: Unique Hero
specialRules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

specialRules.name: Precision Fighter Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls in melee.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Scrapper Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Enhanced Scrapper.

specialRules.name: Scout Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Scout.

specialRules.name: Bounding
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

specialRules.name: Morale Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to Morale Test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Heavy Impact
specialRules.description: Counts as having Impact(X) with hits that have AP(1).

specialRules.name: Ambushing Piercing Shot
specialRules.description: Counts as having Ambush, and its weapons get AP(+1) when shooting on the round in which it deploys via this rule.

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Precision Tag
specialRules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, place X tokens on one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight, or one token on X enemy units within 24" and in line of sight. When attacking, friendly units may remove one token from their target before rolling to hit to get +1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Dodge
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they aren't Fatigued, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls in melee against them.

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Disintegrate
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Tough(3) or higher, this weapon gets AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Shatter
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+3).

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Shooter Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Unpredictable Shooter.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Scrapper
specialRules.description: If this model has Scrapper, enemies taking hits from it must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6 from Scrapper (instead of only results of 6).

specialRules.name: Mind Control
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which must take a Morale Test. If failed you may move it by up to 6" in a straight line in any direction. Units may only be moved once per round in this way.

specialRules.name: Vicious
specialRules.description: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Vicious
specialRules.description: If this model has Vicious, enemies taking hits from it must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6 from Vicious (instead of only results of 6).

specialRules.name: Ranged Shrouding
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy, as long as this unit hasn't started an activation yet this round, attackers get -4"" range to a min. of 6" when shooting at it.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Stealth
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Hero
specialRules.description: Heroes with up to Tough(6) may deploy as part of one multi-model unit without another Hero, but must use the unit’s Defense until all other models have been killed. The Hero’s unit, and units within 6” of friendly Heroes with Tough(9) or higher, may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

specialRules.name: Scout
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. After all other units are deployed, may be deployed anywhere fully within 9” of their deployment zone, over 9” away from non-Scout enemy units. Players alternate in placing Scout units, starting with the player that activates next.

specialRules.name: Impact
specialRules.description: When charging, before either unit attacks, roll X dice, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 2+ the target takes 1 hit.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: This model must take X wounds before being killed. If a model with Tough joins a unit without it, then it is removed last when the unit takes wounds. You must continue to put wounds on the Tough model with most wounds in the unit until it is killed, before starting to put them on the next Tough model (Heroes must be assigned wounds last, even if already wounded).

specialRules.name: Unpredictable
specialRules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Shooter
specialRules.description: When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.
